# Høj rente og dyr olie: Sådan beskytter du din portefølje

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-09-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish investing podcast (Pluto Markets-sponsored) on how to invest through turbulent markets: high rates, expensive oil, the AI-slowdown debate (Trump, Jensen Huang, Amodei) and fears of an AI bubble. The guests call the AI-brake debate 'a storm in a teacup' and see narrative-driven sell-offs as buying opportunities. They also say rising long US rates are the real risk to the debt-funded AI trade. Advice centres on diversifying by correlation (insurance and healthcare such as J&J against AI names like Micron), holding winners for the long term and using ETFs, while Netcompany and MicroStrategy are named as stocks to avoid.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ NETC — Netcompany | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest Joachim: the most misunderstood stock, marketed as a Danish AI winner, but as a consultancy AI disrupts it.

#### Reasoning

Joachim (guest) argues Netcompany's IT-consulting products can be delivered at the same quality and much lower price by smaller AI-enabled players. That makes it an AI loser rather than an AI winner, as the AI hit to Accenture and other consultancies shows. He says it has branded itself as an AI stock without substance.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Netcompany shows AI-driven margin or revenue gains
- if consulting peers stop losing value to AI

> *"Jeg tror i virkeligheden, at den aktie, jeg føler er mest misforståelig nu, det er nok Netcompany."*

---

### ⛔ MSTR — MicroStrategy | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Christian would rather own Bitcoin directly than through MicroStrategy. Joachim agrees he feels negative about the stock.

#### Reasoning

Offhand comment from guest Christian when asked for a stock he would never own: if he wanted Bitcoin exposure he would buy it directly rather than through MicroStrategy's structure. Joachim agrees. The view is casual rather than a researched thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if MicroStrategy trades at a discount to its Bitcoin holdings

> *"Og hvis jeg skulle investere i bitcoin, så ville jeg hellere købe min bitcoin-serie."*

---

### 🟡 GOOGL — Alphabet | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Christian has held Alphabet for 14 years and keeps holding winners while the case is intact.

#### Reasoning

Christian (guest) holds winners as long as the original case is intact and the price rise matches earnings growth. Alphabet, held for 14 years, is his example. He would sell only if he found a clearly better place for the money.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the investment case is no longer intact
- if the price runs far ahead of earnings
- if a better opportunity appears

> *"Alphabet i 14 år har jeg holdt den."*

---

### 🟡 MU — Micron | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Christian has held Micron (and Nvidia) for many years as a long-term winner in AI with a positive case.

#### Reasoning

Christian (guest) holds Micron long term as an AI winner with a positive case, and uses it as the AI counterpart to J&J in his correlation example. The main risk he names is an aggressive rise in rates that could pull the rug from under the debt-funded AI trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- aggressive rise in long rates hitting the AI trade
- if earnings stop justifying the price

> *"som du selv var inde på at holde Micron Nvidia i mange, mange år."*

---

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Christian has held it for many years. The AI-brake talk is a 'storm in a teacup', and narrative-driven dips are buying opportunities.

#### Reasoning

The guests argue no AI slowdown will happen because Trump won't regulate it. Sell-offs driven by narratives, like the DeepSeek scare, have proved to be buying opportunities. The real risk is rising long US rates hurting the debt-heavy AI build-out.

#### Sell Triggers

- aggressive, fast rise in long rates
- fundamental (not narrative) negative news about AI demand

> *"Når der sker det, at nogle aktier falder på, at der er en, der skriver et essay, så er det som regel en god købsmulighed."*

---

### 🟠 JNJ — Johnson & Johnson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Christian cites it as a healthcare diversifier with a positive case that is weakly correlated with AI stocks.

#### Reasoning

Christian recommends adding assets with low correlation to AI names, such as insurance and underweighted healthcare. He gives J&J as the example: a stock that moves at different times from Micron but still has a positive long-term case.

#### Sell Triggers

- if its correlation with AI stocks rises
- if its healthcare case deteriorates

> *"hvis du har sådan en aktie som Johnson & Johnson, og så sætter den over for Micron, så svinger de op og ned på helt forskellige tidspunkter, men de kan begge to have en positiv case."*

---
